claims.text: The Frontend lane's only task is TSK-07 (STORY-07), in repository ap_portal. Its files in budget are src/ap_portal/index.js, package.json (version only) and tests/portal.test.js.
Repository ap_portal is available locally. The agent identity has write access and git status is clean.
The working branch is feature/story, created from dev at ff761ee. HEAD points to refs/heads/feature/story.
Both main and dev point to commit ff761ee.
The remote origin is on GitHub. main and dev track it. feature/story has no upstream configured yet.
No repository creation is needed. No Databricks, other workspace or database is used.
ap_portal uses Node.js 22 with node:test. Its CI command is node ci.mjs, which requires line coverage of at least 90%, bans console.log and eval(, and limits lines to 140 characters.
The current version is 2.3.0 in both src/ap_portal/index.js and package.json. index.js exports VERSION, LABELS, formatAmount and renderAgingSummary.
Commit messages start with the story ID, and the task ID may follow. The branch convention is feature/<story>.

open_questions: RA-1 (non-blocking, Developer): The working branch is named feature/story, but the convention is feature/<story>. For TSK-07 that would be feature/STORY-07. Should we keep feature/story, or should the spine rename it before FE-06?
